title: Outcome dashboard for adopted entries + reuse events
context: A dashboard that reads the outcome ledger to surface adopted entries and verified reuse events supports success-metric tracking for the catalog. It consumes only committed ledger data, no individual-level data. No partner is yet secured, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Deliver an outcome dashboard that reads the outcome ledger and reports adopted entries + reuse events, as a PR.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads the outcome ledger and displays adopted entries and verified reuse events, supporting success-metric tracking.
Consumes only committed ledger/metadata; no individual-level data.
Code MIT-licensed; tests + CI green; DCO signed-off.
